title: All-h original C/C source sector is empty by generalized-quadrangle girth eight
statement: For every genuine original W(3,2^h), h>=1, and every pair of complete separately globally injected original point/line physical-pair maps f,g, there is NO set Q of six distinct original point-line incidence IDs with point source multiplicity C=(2,2,2) AND line source multiplicity C=(2,2,2). Such a six-edge original simple bipartite incidence graph would be a 6-cycle, impossible in the GQ incidence graph of girth 8.

quantifiers.domain: arbitrary complete separate globally injected ORIGINAL point and line maps, reused across all six-incidence sets

external_dependencies: Genuine original GQ W(3,s) point-line incidence graph has girth eight; original incidence graph simple; both source C profiles force degree two on three distinct point and line factors.
limitations: Absence of genuine ORIGINAL C/C source motifs does not prohibit physically overlapping cycles on independently selected columns.
GQ girth alone does not establish a lower bound on any of the seven positive GF(5) classes.
The model excludes synthetic physical six-column patterns that are not genuine original incidence IDs.
falsification_boundary: Require the SAME six genuine original incidence IDs and source factor multiplicity C on both sides. A physical 6-cycle from different event IDs is not a counterexample.
